Title: KingCamp Extra Wide High Back Camping Chair
Description:
Extra wide high-back camping chair with a mesh back and padded headrest. The aluminum frame, carry bag and mesh storage pocket are listed for this chair. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • 600D Oxford seat fabric with a mesh back.
  • Aluminum frame; product weight 1.5 kg (3.3 lb) per chair.
  • Rated weight capacity: 150 kg (330 lb) per chair.
  • Packed product size 52 x 13 x 17 cm; carry bag and mesh storage pocket included.

Title: KingCamp WILLOW C20 Lounge Chair with Side Table
Description:
WILLOW C20 lounge chair with five backrest positions, a side table and side pockets. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • Five backrest positions from 120 to 180 degrees.
  • Textilene surface on a spray-coated steel frame.
  • Maximum load: 120 kg (264 lb) per chair; product weight 6.6 kg (14.5 lb) per chair.
  • Open size 190 x 59 x 34/37 cm; packed product size 76 x 15 x 60 cm for one chair.
  • Each chair is supplied with a pillow, side bag and outer bag.

Title: KingCamp Oversized Director Chair with Side Table
Description:
Oversized director chair with padded seat, foam armrests, retractable side table and cup holder. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • Polyester seat fabric with padding on a steel frame.
  • Rated static load: 200 kg (440 lb) per chair; seat front-edge static load: 180 kg (396 lb) per chair.
  • Product weight 5.7 kg (12.6 lb) per chair.
  • Open size 50 x 55 x 48/92 cm; folded size 52 x 15 x 50 cm for one chair.

Title: KingCamp MAGNOLIA B40 Padded Lounge Chair
Description:
MAGNOLIA B40 padded lounge chair with full-length PU foam padding and five reclining positions including flat.

  • 600D Oxford fabric with PVC coating and a powder-coated steel frame.
  • Maximum static load: 200 kg (440.9 lb); seat-edge load: 150 kg (330.6 lb).
  • Product weight 8.8 kg (19.4 lb); folded size 80 x 15 x 72.5 cm.
  • One lounge chair with an adjustable pillow and detachable side storage pocket.

Title: KingCamp ORCHID C20 Hammock Chair with Footrest
Description:
ORCHID C20 hammock chair with adjustable backrest, detachable footrest, mesh back, padded headrest, cup pockets and shoulder bag.

  • 600D Oxford polyester and nylon mesh; aluminum-alloy and Q195 steel frame.
  • Rated static load: 250 kg (551 lb) per chair; seat front-edge static load: 180 kg (396 lb) per chair.
  • Net weight 5.1 kg (11.2 lb) per chair; folded size 19.5 x 18.5 x 93.5 cm for one chair.
  • Cup pockets and a shoulder bag included.

Title: KingCamp Mesh Folding Director Chair
Description:
Mesh folding director chair with folding side table, built-in cup holder and padded seat, back and armrests. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • 600D Oxford seat material on a steel-tube frame.
  • Folding side table with built-in cup holder.
  • Weight capacity 136 kg (300 lb) per chair; product weight 5.4 kg (11.9 lb) per chair.
  • Packed product size 50 x 48 x 15 cm for one chair.

Title: KingCamp LEMON C20 Double Butterfly Chair
Description:
LEMON C20 double butterfly chair with one continuous double seat for two people, a detachable padded seat cover and one folding frame.

  • One double-seat chair with an overall width of 132 cm.
  • 600D Cationic Oxford fabric over a Q195 steel-tube frame.
  • Product weight 8.5 kg (18.7 lb) per chair; packed product size 32 x 25 x 95 cm for one chair.
  • Includes one frame, one double seat cover, one carry bag and two compression straps.

Title: KingCamp Lightweight Folding Camp Chair
Description:
Lightweight folding camp chair with adjustable armrests, mesh cup holder, steel frame and shoulder carry bag. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • 600D Oxford seat on a steel-tube frame.
  • Maximum static load: 120 kg (265 lb) per chair; maximum impact load: 100 kg (220 lb) per chair.
  • Product weight 5.3 lb per chair.
  • Packed product size 6.3 x 6.3 x 32.6 in for one chair; shoulder carry bag included.

Title: KingCamp Reclined Mesh-Back Camping Chair
Description:
Reclined mesh-back camping chair with padded seat and back, cup holder, side pocket and quick folding frame.

  • 600D Oxford seat material and a steel-tube frame.
  • Weight capacity 136 kg (300 lb) per chair.
  • Product weight 4.3 kg (9.4 lb) per chair; packed product size 97 x 18 x 17 cm for one chair.
  • Quick folding frame with a cup holder and side pocket.

Title: KingCamp Low Sling Folding Beach Chair
Description:
Low sling folding beach chair with three seating positions including lay-flat, foam pillow, mesh back, storage pouch and rear towel bar. Choose a single chair or a two-chair pack from the available color and pack combinations.

  • 600D Oxford seat material with an aluminum-alloy frame.
  • Weight capacity 136 kg (300 lb) per chair.
  • Three seating positions, including lay-flat.
  • Foam pillow, storage pouch and rear towel bar included.
